description: This file defines a singleton object ServiceLocator that provides access to a lazily-initialized AppRepository instance for dependency management. It sets up database access via Room, secure shared preferences, and constructs the repository with necessary dependencies.

classes.name: ServiceLocator
classes.description: A singleton object providing centralized access to the AppRepository, responsible for initializing and caching the repository instance.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Returns the singleton AppRepository instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: buildRepository
methods.description: Constructs and configures the AppRepository with database, preferences, and other dependencies.
